text:
jordan-alliances: Quick sync — we need a lightweight ROE for SI co-sell when deals come through cloud marketplaces or HW partner channels. Goal: clear handoff, who owns intro, timing for joint announcement, and pre-checks (SLA, data residency, private deploy ok?).
sarah-partners: +1. Can we standardize a single mapping format for leads? e.g. `account_name -> SI + SDR + AE` so routing is deterministic.
mike-sales: Love that. For enterprise deals avoid marketplace leads auto-assigned — require SDR qualification first. Marketplace leads for <$50k ARR can auto-route to SI partner.
liam-eng: Heads-up: for Private deployments we need a security checklist completed before we do joint demos — SSO, KMS, and infra contact. If SI takes early ownership, they'll need the checklist too.
olivia-customer-success: Also make sure we agree on announcement cadence — CS needs 2 weeks post-PO to prepare onboarding content if we do a joint customer announcement.
sarah-partners: Proposed ROE (draft): 1) Lead intake: marketplace leads go to intake queue; tag `mp-sourced`. 2) Tiering: <$50k -> SI auto-route; >=$50k -> SDR handoff to AE + SI engagement invite. 3) Handoff artifact: always attach mapping doc `acct -> SI_contact, AE, SDR, proposed play` (one-liner). 4) Pre-demo gates for Private/HW: security checklist + cust-signed NDA if needed. 5) Announcement: optional, request 14d before publish, CS + legal sign-off.
jordan-alliances: Nice — can you put that mapping template in Confluence and link it here? I'll add a flow chart for routing.
sarah-partners: Will do, creating page now — link: https://redwood.atl/confluence/si-co-sell-mp-routing (draft).
marketplace-bot: New marketplace listing detected for partner "VertexHW" — listing id 2026-03-VX-001. Recommend we flag for SI onboarding.
mike-sales: Flag accepted. @sarah-partners can you assign an initial owner for VertexHW intake?
sarah-partners: Assigning to @jordan-alliances for outreach, copying @liam-eng for security checklist coordination.
jordan-alliances: I'll reach out to VertexHW + their SI this afternoon. Suggest a weekly 15m triage on Wednesdays for the first month. Anyone opposed? :calendar:
olivia-customer-success: Works for CS. Please add customer onboarding readiness checklist to the Confluence page.
liam-eng: Sending the security checklist as a snippet here for quick copy:
```
- SSO provider & SAML metadata
- KMS integration type
- Network topology & VPC peering requirements
- Data residency constraints
- Contact for infra onboarding
```
sarah-partners: Great. I'll merge into the page and add the mapping template. After the page is live, let's run a pilot with VertexHW next week.
jordan-alliances: Thanks team — action items: Sarah -> Confluence + mapping template; Jordan -> outreach to VertexHW + SI; Liam -> prep security checklist doc; Olivia -> onboarding readiness + announce window. Weekly triage Wednesday 11:15am PT.
mike-sales: 👍 will update pipeline rules to reflect marketplace auto-routing thresholds.
olivia-customer-success: One ask — if SI is owning post-contract onboarding, CS should still be tagged as backup in case SI lacks bandwidth. Add `CS: backup_onboard` to mapping.
sarah-partners: Noted and added to template.
jordan-alliances: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock this as the default ROE for marketplace+HW SI co-sell and run pilot.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: schedule marketplace verification call within 3 business days for listing 2026-03-VX-001.
